title: Tracked reconstruction parity and input-gradient invariants on the 40 added cases
scope: Exact fresh tracked/default forward comparison on every query, coefficients and isovalue; finite input gradients, translation equivariance and uniform-normal-scaling invariance for a centered mean field loss. First-order derivatives with fixed assignments. Complements existing finite-difference tests; does not independently validate arbitrary directional derivatives or changing tree/mesh topology.
